learning: If losses persist at y=0.045, the loss depends on speed on the curve, so the next controller lever is base_speed (reduce toward 1.4), which I will make only if the geometry race shows losses persisting. If losses clear, the geometry lever to test next is sensor_size 0.012 for the oval floor.
notes: Builder's y=0.045, ±0.055 span geometry with the iteration 7 controller unchanged, so the race isolates the forward-row position. Expected: line losses near 0 on s-bend and slalom, s-bend progress between 0.04 and 0.157.
rationale: The Builder's proposal moves the sensor row from y=0.06 to y=0.045 and keeps the ±0.055 span from iteration 7. Iteration 7 (y=0.06) logged 0.9 line losses per trial on s-bend and 1.0 on slalom, while iteration 5 (y=0.03, ±0.05) logged none, so the forward row is the source of the losses. Iteration 6 showed that forward sensing is the only lever that has moved bend progress (s-bend 0.040 to 0.157). Iteration 8 keeps the iteration 7 controller unchanged (base_speed 1.6, kp 2.5, ki 0.5, kd 0.15, weights [-2,-1,0,1,2], last_direction). Changing base_speed now would confound the single-lever geometry test, and the Builder's stated rule is that base_speed is the next lever only if losses persist at y=0.045. Oval max_error has sat at 0.060 to 0.063 through every change, and no controller gain has moved it, so I expect no oval change. I expect line losses to fall toward 0 on s-bend and slalom with s-bend progress staying above 0.04.
